verdict.rationale: The Comptroller documents two system-to-system filing channels: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) for businesses with many outlets, leases, schedules or authorities, and electronic franchise-report submission through approved tax-preparation provider software. That shows a transmitter/batch-style machine channel exists. However, the pack never shows how to enroll in EDI or how a software provider gets approved, and the probes find no public API spec; the only keyless rail is a read-only open-data dataset, not a transaction channel. missing for 10: published EDI/transmitter enrollment path, software-provider approval process, technical specifications for the EDI channel, system-account credentials model, independent corroboration.
